dataset_title: Isoelectric and acid protein-recovery evidence for green biomass extracts
source_title: Enhancing Protein Recovery in Green Biorefineries by Lignosulfonate-Assisted Precipitation
source_location: Row-level table, figure, and method locators are recorded in recovery.csv and recovery_metadata.json; active candidates REC-005 and REC-006 cite Figure 5/Conclusion and Materials and Methods.
license: Mixed source rights: la Cour et al. (2019) is CC BY; the reuse terms for the separate Nissen et al. (2022) abstract record are not verified. No blanket license is asserted for the combined table.
evidence_class: Peer-reviewed observations and reported process conditions; row-level evidence classes and provenance are retained in recovery.csv and recovery_metadata.json.
material_scope: Cultivated ryegrass, grass-clover and red-clover juices plus a separately sourced alfalfa abstract value; not GreenHub roadside-grass performance data.
activation_state: Partially runtime active: REC-005 and REC-006 are D4, PR1-only, opt-in literature candidates; all other rows retain their own source and transferability limits. No structural workbook default was changed.
applicability: REC-005 reports total-N precipitation for cultivated ryegrass juice, not purified soluble-protein recovery. REC-006 records the source pH interval 4.0–4.5 and uses 4.5 only as an opt-in scalar endpoint. Both studies used a water-assisted second press and juice clarification, unlike the GreenHub roadside-grass process boundary.
measurement_basis: Each row preserves its reported analyte, denominator, unit, material, and treatment conditions. The model-facing values are class-C transfers or scalar selections where noted; literature source quality B does not make those mappings project measurements.
conversion_and_scaling: REC-005 is copied as 0.38 kg total N precipitated/kg total N in clarified ryegrass juice and mapped as a C-class proxy to the model soluble-protein recovery fraction. REC-006 copies the 4.0–4.5 pH interval and selects 4.5 as a scalar endpoint assumption. No scale-up conversion is applied.
uncertainty: REC-005: n=3 and mean ± SD are shown in Figure 5, but numeric SD is not tabulated; transfer and denominator uncertainty remain. REC-006: the source gives a pH range without a probability distribution; GreenHub titration demand and batch response remain unknown. See row-level metadata.
provenance_note: The table combines multiple sources. Source DOIs, retrieval/license details, exact locations, and row-level applicability are retained in the row table, sidecar metadata, and source register. Only REC-005/REC-006 are selected by the PR1 literature-default/expert-override resolver path; their source rows and quality limitations are reported in simulation provenance.
